headline: Mexicana de Aviación to grow 30% in passengers this year and add 98 winter operations: Bojórquez
summary: Mexicana de Aviación expects passenger numbers to grow 30% this year and plans 98 operations in winter. It averaged 735 operations a month from January to September.
why: Mexicana de Aviación is a Mexican airline, and its capacity growth reflects demand in the domestic air travel market.
original_headline: Mexicana de Aviación crecerá 30% en pasajeros este año y sumará 98 operaciones en invierno: Bojórquez
